description: This Dart source file defines the AuthService class, which provides authentication-related functionalities such as registration, login, and token refresh for a Flutter application. It interacts with an API client and manages session states.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class handling user authentication processes, integrating with API endpoints and session management.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password; on success, may trigger auto-login.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in a user with email and password, obtaining tokens and updating the session.

methods.name: tryRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh authentication tokens by calling the refresh endpoint.
